title: Hedge Iris董事：DeepSeek抢占token份额，蒸馏技术成新挑战
speaker: Felix Wong

segments.en: So we have a lot of evidence out there that deepseek, through their new entry into V4, they're taking a lot of token share. I don't see that changing, even with Tsupu catching up, with frontier models like Clawed and GPT, at least on the intelligent level, but watch closely the pricing.
segments.zh: 我们有大量证据表明，DeepSeek通过V4抢占了大量token份额。即使智谱在智能水平上追赶Claude和GPT，我认为这种情况也不会改变，但要密切关注定价。

segments.en: The token pricing did not go up. And does that same thesis apply to, I mean, if deepseek is, I mean, just to use that phrase, the deepseek moment of this is the Chinese model, it's low cost, you don't have to be at the front here of what's available technologically speaking.
segments.zh: token价格没有上涨。同样的逻辑是否适用于其他AI公司？DeepSeek时刻意味着中国模式低成本，你不需要站在技术最前沿。

segments.en: Does your thesis apply to other AI plays then? That the same pricing power isn't actually there. It applies to pretty much all of the other LLM models, including many Macs, including Quinn, even Tencent.
segments.zh: 你的论点是否适用于其他AI公司？同样的定价权并不存在。它适用于几乎所有其他LLM模型，包括许多Mac、Quinn，甚至腾讯。

segments.en: So I think this is a very important moment here. And people are trying to digest it, but what I'm trying to say is deepseek definitely have structure advantages, particularly with the one key infrastructure that allowed them the price as low as they are able to.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是一个非常重要的时刻。人们正在消化它，但我想说的是DeepSeek确实拥有结构性优势，尤其是关键基础设施使其能够定价如此之低。

segments.en: Another challenge I want to mention about this company that I don't think is well understood is distillation. So you may have heard Fable 5, Mythos 5 being banned temporarily or permanently.
segments.zh: 另一个我认为未被充分理解的挑战是蒸馏技术。你可能听说过Fable 5、Mythos 5被暂时或永久禁止。

segments.en: We don't know yet from anthropic. Why does this matter to the Tsupu thesis?
segments.zh: 我们还不清楚Anthropic的情况。这对智谱的论点有何影响？
